result.summary: Found a major bottom-navigation layout defect: the system gesture indicator overlaps the navigation controls, and the navigation bar is clipped by the bottom screen edge.

issues.description: A thick horizontal gesture/home indicator is rendered across the bottom navigation bar, obscuring the search and saved/bookmark icons.
issues.suggestion: Respect the device safe-area inset and position the bottom navigation content above the system gesture area so the indicator does not overlap interactive controls.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar is vertically cut off at the bottom of the viewport; the lower portions of its icons, especially the profile icon, are not fully visible.
issues.suggestion: Increase the bottom navigation bar's safe-area padding/height and ensure all navigation icons fit fully within the visible viewport.
